exposure: Existing canonical DEVELOPMENT contexts, already evaluated; not protected confirmation
candidate: Original archived candidate0, asserted exactly zero
action_coordinates: Literal normalized model-input coordinates, not physical force units
off_center_omission: Fixed before outcomes to bound execution; no later outcome-dependent expansion

capture.site: block output, newest 256 visual patches, all feature coordinates

precision_boundary: Same loaded FP32 weights and FP32 encoded context/actions. Actual BF16 is CUDA autocast of recursive predictor/unroll including earlier horizons, not BF16 encoding, all-BF16 operations, or a single-kernel intervention. Posthoc condition rounds each captured FP32 field to BF16 then back to FP32.
center: Each condition uses its own zero-offset field
interpolation_scope: Symmetric four-anchor center prediction; cubic interpolant at center is quadratic-compatible and does not identify third-order structure
metrics: central first/second difference means and RMS at both radii
primary_analysis: Paired context-level log(cubic center MSE / linear center MSE) by task/layer/condition; preserve raw zeros and undefined ratios without epsilon. All 64 contexts and all 6 blocks retained. Analysis is separate from this measurement implementation.
parity: Each precision runs the same five-anchor batch once unhooked and once with read-only capture hooks; require exact output bytes and unchanged Python/NumPy/Torch CPU/CUDA RNG. Batch-size-one versus batch-size-five byte equivalence is not claimed.
forward_budget: One model load and one FP32 context encoding per case; 4 H6 five-anchor-batch forwards per case including paired parity, 256 total for 64 cases. Posthoc rounding requires no model forward.
preservation: GPU fields are reduced immediately, not written to laptop. Persist all direct metrics, Gram matrices, bindings, timing, STARTED/report/DONE receipts; failed/partial output directories remain distinct and preserved.
runtime_gate: Deployment owner measures one tagged registered setup case before full dispatch; setup ID remains part of the fixed cohort and no outcome-based subset selection is allowed. Incremental compute bound approximately USD10 requires owner enforcement.
